title: The Cyanide serial Poisonings
evidence: Traces of potassium cyanide retrieved from hotel bathroom drains
Stolen gold jewelry recovered from local pawn shops
Fake bus stand identity cards and forged marriage papers
modus_operandi: Lures women under the pretext of marriage, takes them to hotels, convinces them to take contraceptive pills laced with potassium cyanide, steals their jewelry, and leaves the scene.
personality_disorder: Antisocial Personality Disorder (Psychopathy) with extreme deceitfulness, lack of empathy, and predatory financial exploitation.
common_traits: Targeting financially vulnerable women seeking marriage
Robbery of gold and cash post-mortem
summary: Serial operator linked to 20 poisoning cases following a meticulous pattern of deceit, poison administration, and financial gain.
